description: Climb the trail to the windy, bare summit on the ridge east of campus and look out: the rock and the cairn around you, the whole campus below, the shore beyond it, and the sun going down over the water, worked out from its real position. Says how many stones are on the cairn. Nothing is stored.

dog.description: Optional: bring the campus dog along (it lives at the doghouse; see visit_the_dog). Pass the name you gave it, or "yes".

name: climb_to_the_summit
title: Climb to the summit
